RESEARCH_MUNICIPALITY.notes: Seattle operates under a mayor-council form of government. [3, 4, 9, 16] The Mayor is the head of the executive branch, and the City Council is the legislative body. [3, 5, 9] The Seattle City Council consists of nine members, with seven elected by electoral districts and two elected in citywide at-large positions. [9, 13] Bruce Harrell assumed office as Mayor on January 1, 2022, and his current term ends on December 31, 2025. [6, 7] Debora Juarez was appointed to the District 5 seat on July 28, 2025. [15]
